## Endpoints

### Data Read (2)
- `GET /palm-trees/api/web_experiments` — Get a list of active web experiments.
- `GET /palm-trees/api/web_experiments/` — Get a list of active web experiments.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /palm-trees/{palm-treeId}` — Update an existing palm tree.
- `POST /palm-trees/{palm-treeId}/` — Add a new palm tree.

## Quick Start

Here are a few examples to get you started using the `poke` API:

```typescript
// Get a list of active web experiments.
async function getWebExperiments() {
  const experiments = await client.getPalmTreesApiWebExperiments();
  console.log("Active web experiments:", experiments);
  return experiments;
}
```

```typescript
// Update an existing palm tree.
async function updatePalmTree(palmTreeId: string, updateData: any) {
  try {
    const result = await client.postPalmTreesPalmTreeId({ palmTreeId: palmTreeId, requestBody: updateData });
    console.log("Palm tree updated successfully:", result);
    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error updating palm tree:", error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

This skill provides access to Poke's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.

- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

- Access Poke data without official API access
- Automate actions on poke.com (faster than browser automation)
